title: Birth in Lakeland and years on medicine shows and circuses
summary: Born 1898 in Lakeland, brought to New Orleans at two months; later left for Chicago and Detroit with medicine shows, theaters and circuses.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I see. And where were you born?
I was born in Lakeland, but I was brought here when I was a baby.
That's Lakeland, Louisiana? That's right. And how old were you, you say?
I was born in 1898, April 22nd. This next birth I'll be 62. I mean next April. The 22nd.
And how old were you when you were brought to the city?
I was around about two months old.
And how long have you lived here? All the time since?

Well, I've been here. I stayed here around about 20 years and I left here and went to Chicago, Detroit. I used to be on the medicine shows. Used to work in theaters and so on. Sideshows and the circus. John Robinson Circus. I was with Downey Brothers, Sells and Floteau. I was with the big chief Indian selling medicine out through the country.
